positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of the Avamar development team that provides data deduplication, fast secure backup and recovery services for enterprises.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description: Part of the ESB Console design and development team. The ESB Console project is a high performance run-time tool for monitoring and managing composite applications and components. The project key features include multiple domains management, multi-level integration points, personalization, delegated security, module pluggability, asynchronous module communications (AJAX) and technology independence.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer/Architect
positions.description:
Leading the design and development of the Enterprise Monitoring system. Designed the overall System Architecture for Enterprise Monitoring system. The major functions of the Monitoring System are monitoring the health and performance of all the components in the enterprise network. The Monitoring System also provides functionalities for auto-discovery, control management and event notifications of enterprise components.
The client component is based on web applications with the Struts layer and is hosted by Apache    Tomcat server. The Enterprise Monitoring System is based on the J2EE, JMX and JMS technologies

Work on the eGate platform, in particular, the logical host component which consists of  JREs, jars, configurations, application servers (e.g. STC Application Server, WebLogic, WebSphere), message
servers (STC Message Server, Non-Stop JMS, MQ JMS) , and management agent.  The eGate platform is based on the J2EE, JMX, JMS technologies

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the Modeling component of the Network Resource Control layer which includes Order Management, Service Modeling and management, Service Element modeling and management, Element Behavior Modeling and workflows.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Technical Lead for the design and development of the EMS for a long-haul optical DWDM transport system (Latus Lightworks). My responsibilities include assisting and creating screen designs and layouts, provide solution strategies, provide technical guidance and resolution of issues, and project coordination for the EMS project.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked various projects like 
 * CS3K SoftSwitch - software network infrastructure offering full-featured telephone services 
* eMobility - HLR/AC services  to Wireless IN and Wireless Data Services in GSM and MTX networks.
* Inca M10 NMS Project (Voice over IP) - ¨	complete Voice over IP solution for the Enterprise. 
* Road Warrior - a Voice over IP product based on the ITG switch
* Symposium Multimedia Conferencing Project (CTI) - software solution offering call management, video conferencing, app sharing, and white boarding.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented the Easy Series of products (Easy Loans, Easy Expense Reports, Easy Landlord, Easy Lists and Labels), and Amortizer Series.  Collaborated and worked on the Profit Point Accounting, REMS Property Manager, and REMS Investor. Designed and implemented Agfa Font Manager, 25/1-in-one SoftCartridge, and the FontMaker Series. Also worked on a number of device drivers including OTC Laser Matrix, OTC DotMatrix, Toshiba PageLaser using Microsoft DDK.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Research and development of TeX macro packages, creating new device drivers for laser printers. Developed a context-sensitive text-editor based on the Epsilon editor for TeX Mate macro package. This editor provides run-time command syntax validation and error-checking
